create_paco_evaluator: create a PACOEvaluator instance to evaluate object detection and segmentation outputs on PACO datasets
run_paco_evaluation: run PACO evaluation on object and part detection predictions with hierarchical attribute AP reporting
convert_instances_to_coco_json: convert Detectron2 instances to LVIS-compatible COCO JSON format with bounding boxes, masks, and attributes
evaluate_predictions_on_lvis: evaluate LVIS-format predictions with configurable max detections per image and optional attribute evaluation
process_predictions: process model inputs and outputs into LVIS prediction format for batch evaluation
